source.quote: Holo Audio specification tables via retailers and 6moons, read 2026-11-20: USB and I2S over HDMI at PCM 44.1 kHz to 1.536 MHz, 32-bit, with native DSD to DSD1024 over USB and I2S and DoP to DSD512 over USB; coaxial, optical and AES/EBU at PCM 44.1-192 kHz, 24-bit, with DoP DSD64. Listings differ slightly on the DoP ceiling of the S/PDIF inputs.
